The PDF fetch returned compressed binary rather than readable text. I’ll extract the PDF locally and inspect the equation containing the bag volume.
```python
extract_cmd = await run_command("curl -L --max-time 30 -s 'https://journals.le.ac.uk/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684/1496' -o ./fish_paper.pdf && pdftotext -layout ./fish_paper.pdf - | grep -in -C 4 -E 'volume|bag|0\\.1777|0\\.0016' | head -80")
print(extract_cmd)
```
I’ll use the extracted equation context to distinguish the total bag volume from the fish-volume term.
```python
print(extract_cmd)
```
0.1777 m³
